Traveller-facing document regime: X markers abolished, passports confiscated, visa refusals and lifetime-ineligibility risk; bathroom bans criminal in places; custody harm documented. Working courts and hate-crime law partly offset.

Unenforced 10-year sodomy statute plus a gender-expression public-solicitation offence aimed at presentation; no protection, activist murdered, rising hostility. Traditional third-gender acceptance and no documented enforcement temper it.

Decriminalised 2016, 2024 hate-crime enhancement covering gender identity, no documented trans targeting, border or facilities exposure. Silence in a functioning state reads mildly positive; enforcement data absent.
